title: Austin Greenlights Key Economic Funds
summary:
*   Austin officials held an emergency meeting to swiftly approve federal Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) funds for local economic development initiatives.
*   Key funding was authorized for the National Business League and the Austin Minority Economic Development Corporation through September 30, 1981.
*   The city received verbal assurance from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) that it could proceed with the new contracts, despite some minor budgetary concerns from HUD.
*   A proposal for additional funding for the East Austin Coalition for Economic Development Corporation (EACEDC) was deferred to a future agenda for consideration.

Councilmember Duncan apologized for making an error in the Agenda. It was his intention to

Mr. Carlos Herrera, Director of Human Services, stated, "Subsequent to the meeting that
was held in San Antonio we forwarded to HUD the information that was required to indicate
to HUD that the two EDC's, NBL and AMECDC had been heard through the citizen review
process and had been deliberated at the City Council and the Minutes reflected this. HUD
has indicated to us verbally that as a result of that proof they will not be impeded. They
indicated to us that the City Council could be advised that you do not have a restriction
in entering into a 6th year contract. They did caution us and advise us on some other
concerns they had in terms of budget levels and some of the staff positions that one of
the agencies has. HUD indicated they may have a question on the level of where they may
draw the line in terms of directing the city to do something or recommending would be very
fine. At this point we do not know until we receive an official communication." Motion
